description: Legitimate-repeat fixtures and one heterogeneous-object fixture for repetition_collapse. Each fixture carries an explicit expected_label: 'loop' means the buffer is a degenerate repetition collapse the detector MUST flag; 'allow' means the buffer is a legitimate repeating structure the detector MUST NOT flag. The detector output is compared byte-for-byte across runs. Every 'allow' fixture's repeating unit is intentionally longer than RC_DEFAULT_MIN_SPAN_BYTES=60 so the corpus exercises region/JSON suppression, not just the min_span pre-filter.

fixtures.label: allow
fixtures.comment: ASCII art inside a fenced block repeats a long line verbatim - structural fence region MUST suppress the loop.

fixtures.label: allow
fixtures.comment: List items echo a repeated bullet body longer than min_span - LIST_BODY region MUST suppress the loop.

fixtures.label: allow
